x: We need some new blood so before April let us see some form from such people as Miller, Thresher, Linstead, Johnston, Stearman, and a return to the team by Hallowell, Davies and Baulch (not new blood but almost indispensable).
Our first team,made up of Shippen, Black, Walker, Robinson, Stearman and Moore wandered between thirteenth and ninth before settling in tenth place- a position far below their capabilities.

Ventor (98th) ran below form and Joe Dooley, although making considerable ground in the latter stages, could only reach 106th. The remaining finishers were Stearman (127), Johnston (136), Jones D.W. (139), Collier (146), and an unfit Sawyer (148).
